query: mutation UpdateTemplateQuery($templateId: ID!, $newQuery: String!, $updateVariables: JSON) { updateTemplateQuery(templateId: $templateId, newQuery: $newQuery, updateVariables: $updateVariables) { success previousQuery template { id identifier name } errors { message } } }

variables.newQuery: query GetTableSchema($tableIdentifier: String!, $includeNodes: Boolean = true, $nodeSampleLimit: Int = 5) { tableByIdentifier(identifier: $tableIdentifier) { id identifier name description nodeCount attributeCount createdAt updatedAt attributes { id identifier name description dataType defaultValue isRequired isUnique table { id identifier } } nodes(pagination: { limit: $nodeSampleLimit }) @include(if: $includeNodes) { nodes { id content title description createdAt } totalCount } } }
